functions.name: equity_shock
functions.signature: (category: str, symmetric_adjustment: float, *, duration_based: Optional[Mapping] = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context, classification: Optional[Mapping] = None)
functions.description:
Shock factor with optional qualified168 route checks, never asset valuation.

Without classification, eligibility remains external. Optional route inputs
bind market/fund scope or existing qualification screens to the chosen factor.
Strategic/long-term recognition and own-funds deductions remain separate.

functions.name: own_funds_scr_allocation
functions.signature: (scr: float, tier1: float, restricted_tier1: float, tier2: float, tier3: float, *, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Validate one proposed full SCR-covering allocation of preclassified tiers.

functions.name: own_funds_mcr_allocation
functions.signature: (mcr: float, basic_tier1: float, restricted_tier1: float, basic_tier2: float, *, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Validate one proposed full MCR-covering allocation of basic own funds.

functions.name: own_funds_basic_before_adjustments
functions.signature: (excess_assets_over_liabilities: float, subordinated_liabilities: float, own_shares: float, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Compose Article88 amounts before further deductions and eligibility limits.

Excess must still include own shares; using an already adjusted surplus
here would double-deduct them. This is not eligible own funds or Tier1.

functions.name: own_funds_reconciliation_reserve
functions.signature: (excess_assets_over_liabilities: float, deductions: Mapping, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Subtract Article70 items, with explicit financial-participation overlap.

Future-premium expected profit is already in the supplied surplus, not an
extra addition. A signed reserve is preserved; no Tier1 eligibility is
inferred from this arithmetic. All deduction categories must be supplied.

functions.name: own_funds_restricted_deduction
functions.signature: (restricted_own_funds: float, portfolio_kind: str, immaterial_simplification: bool, *, notional_scr: float | None = None, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Deduct restricted surplus, or the full elected immaterial RFF amount.

Restricted funds already exclude future shareholder transfers. Materiality,
portfolio classification and notional SCR are externally qualified; no
internal model or arbitrary materiality threshold is supplied here.

functions.name: own_funds_financial_participation_deduction
functions.signature: (participations: Mapping, threshold_basis: float, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Deduct qualified nonexempt financial participations, with per-holding audit.

Each input is a complete participation, not an arbitrary instrument slice.
Article68(3) exemptions and direct/indirect ownership are qualified before
calling. SRC-0135 Guideline5 / SRC-0067 paragraph26 require the basis
BEFORE Article68 deductions; exemptions are not inherited across versions.
Deduction amounts here are not yet allocated to own-funds tiers.

functions.name: rule_profiles
functions.signature: () -> 'dict'
functions.description: Return explicit profile intervals and supported scope, not legal approval.

functions.name: interest_stress
functions.signature: (rate: float, maturity: float, direction: str, *, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Stress a basic annual spot rate; linear factor interpolation including endpoints.

functions.name: lapse_stress
functions.signature: (rate: float, direction: str, *, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Stress the relevant option-exercise rate after the required contract selection.

functions.name: symmetric_adjustment
functions.signature: (current_index: float, average_index: float, *, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Use an externally qualified daily mean; the selected profile determines its window and cap.

functions.name: premium_reserve_risk
functions.signature: (segments: Mapping[str, dict], *, premium_nonproportional_cover: Optional[Mapping] = None, reserve_adjustments: Optional[Mapping] = None, adjustment_reference: str | None = None, uses_usp: bool | None = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Nonlife sigma aggregation with explicit2027 reinsurance/USP qualification.

Future premium80% factors require a declared existing nonproportional cover
in segments1/4/5. Reserve factors are supplied separately; no absence of ADC
is inferred from missing input. Historical callers keep the original API.

functions.name: nonlife_premium_volume
functions.signature: (expected_next_year: float, earned_last_year: float, existing_future_pv: float, future_short_pv: float, future_long_pv: float, *, method: str, cap_evidence: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Article 116 premium volume from externally selected net premium cashflows.

Future short contracts exclude premiums earned in their first twelve months
after recognition; future long contracts use premiums beyond the next twelve
months from valuation. The supplied long-contract PV is still unweighted.
Evidence references record, but cannot substantively verify, paragraph 4.

functions.name: nonlife_reserve_volume
functions.signature: (claims_best_estimate: float, eligible_recoverables: float, *, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Net claims BE; eligible recoverables must exclude208(2) finite/similar RI.

functions.name: premium_reserve_diversification
functions.signature: (*, risk_type: str, segment: str, method: str, uses_usp: bool, regional_volumes: Optional[Mapping[str, dict]] = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Geographic factor from already classified volumes, including mandatory exceptions.

Regional maxima/floors must be calculated regionally: their sum need not
equal the separately calculated segment volume used by the risk function.
This function does not classify countries or validate USP authorisation.

functions.name: health_premium_volume
functions.signature: (expected_next_year: float, earned_last_year: float, existing_future_pv: float, future_short_pv: float, future_long_pv: float, *, method: str, cap_evidence: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Health-NSLT net premium volume; cohort/time selection and evidence are external.

functions.name: health_reserve_volume
functions.signature: (claims_best_estimate: float, eligible_recoverables: float, *, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Health-NSLT claims volume; recoverables exclude208(2) finite/similar RI.

functions.name: health_premium_reserve_risk
functions.signature: (segments: Mapping[str, dict], *, uses_usp: bool, uses_hres: bool, reserve_adjustments: Optional[Mapping] = None, adjustment_reference: str | None = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Four-segment standard selector; USP/HRES are deliberately not substituted.

Use premium_reserve_parameterised_risk for already qualified effective
USP/HRES sigmas. This automatic standard selector does not choose them.

The2027 profile requires all four externally qualified reserve factors,
including explicit ones for segments without a qualifying ADC adjustment.
Historical calculations reject these future-only inputs.

functions.name: health_hres_sigma_bound
functions.signature: (segment: str, risk: str, representative_sigma: float, *, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Bound an external representative estimate; this does not determine an official HRES sigma.

functions.name: health_hres_mixed_sigma
functions.signature: (segment: str, risk: str, non_hres_volume: float, hres_volume: float, hres_sigma: float, *, parameter_reference: str, qualification: Optional[Mapping] = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Mix separately calculated volumes; a source reference is not a legal applicability decision.

Bounds are reported independently instead of silently changing a supplied
external parameter. Optional qualification additionally rejects declared
ineligibility or bound contradictions; omission stays explicitly unchecked.
This component is not the complete HRES risk module.

functions.name: lac_dt_stress_amount
functions.signature: (bscr: float, operational: float, adjustment_tp: float, *, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Loss for the external tax revaluation, before (not after) the tax adjustment.

functions.name: lac_dt
functions.signature: (base_dta: float, base_dtl: float, stressed_dta: float, stressed_dtl: float, *, recoverability_reference: str | None = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

functions.name: scr_standard_formula
functions.signature: (bscr: float, operational: float, adjustment_tp: float, adjustment_dt: float, *, context: solvency2._core.core.Context, capital_addons: Optional[Mapping] = None, purpose: str = 'scr')
functions.description:
Compose standard formula and explicit imposed add-ons, not a full release.

Inputs exclude these add-ons already. For the risk_margin view only the
governance Article37(1)c add-on is removed by37(5); all reference-undertaking
selection underDR38 remains external, not inferred from this view switch.

functions.name: best_estimate_cashflows
functions.signature: (cashflows: Mapping[str, dict], *, runoff_complete: bool, cashflow_reference: str, curve_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Discount already probability-weighted, gross-of-reinsurance cashflows.

No projection model, curve interpolation or compounding convention is
invented here. Discount factors must match the payment dates and currency.
Inflows include premiums, not separately valued reinsurance recoverables.

functions.name: technical_provisions_sum
functions.signature: (best_estimate: float, risk_margin: float, *, replication_applies: bool, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

functions.signature: (market_values: Mapping[str, float], *, cashflow_features: Mapping[str, bool | None], replication_reference: str | None = None, market_reference: str | None = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Market-value arithmetic with mandatory exclusions, not replication approval.

Features concern the selected cashflows. References to all-scenario and
market evidence are retained but their substantive adequacy is external.

functions.name: reinsurance_default_loss
functions.signature: (recoverables_before_adjustment: float, estimated_loss: float, *, method: str, valuation_reference: str | None = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Apply the loss-given-default floor or an explicitly evidenced alternative.

The minimum is not a point estimate and is not a probability of default.
This result must not be used as the full expected default adjustment: its
timing, probabilities and segmentation require a separate calculation.

functions.name: spv_recoverable_cap
functions.signature: (recoverable: float, aggregate_maximum_exposure: float, *, exposure_reference: str | None = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Cap one SPV's separately valued recoverable at its external aggregate exposure.

Do not substitute collateral or sum unrelated counterparties here. Contract
boundaries, basis risk and the exposure evidence remain external prerequisites.

functions.name: reinsurance_recoverable_cashflows
functions.signature: (cashflows: Mapping[str, dict], *, partition: Mapping[str, str], runoff_complete: bool, projection_reference: str, curve_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Discount externally selected expected recoveries at their own payment dates.

Signed values remain signed. No gross-claim date substitution, default
adjustment, SPV cap or claim/deposit qualification is performed implicitly.

functions.name: reinsurance_default_adjustment
functions.signature: (cashflows: Mapping[str, dict], *, partition: Mapping[str, str], runoff_complete: bool, projection_reference: str, curve_reference: str, noncollateral_mitigation_included: bool, context: solvency2._core.core.Context, separate_noncollateral_mitigation: Optional[Mapping[str, dict]] = None)
functions.description:
PV of already probability-weighted shortfalls; positive result is a deduction.

Payment-date differences may be negative (e.g. delayed receipts), but a
negative total needs review. Default times, PD, litigation and collateral
effects must already be in the external projection: never multiply PD twice.

functions.name: reinsurance_nonlife_allocation
functions.signature: (payments: Mapping[str, dict], *, target_provision: str, eligibility_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Allocate already eligible payments using their external gross-claims linkage.

False means premium only after prior eligibility under Article 41: it is
not permission to include settled claims, unrelated payments or deposits.
Call separately for each date and homogeneous counterparty/LoB/type slice.

functions.signature: (rate: float, period: str, *, rate_basis: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

valuation model must define coherent state transitions and joint projection.

functions.name: health_biometric_stress
functions.signature: (rate: float, shock: str, *, rate_basis: str, selected: bool | None, selection_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

Stress only explicitly selected SLT health contracts, not their BOF valuation.

external. Probability and intensity bases are never silently interconverted.

functions.name: health_nslt_lapse_factor
functions.signature: (category: str, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: NSLT health event share; do not apply SLT's three-scenario selection here.

functions.name: nonlife_lapse_factor

 Article90a permits contract-group selection for118(1)(a) only with88 and
35(a-c) grouping qualification. The external reference must evidence this
 if used; it does not change the event share or remove joint valuation.

functions.name: nonprop_property_cat_loss
functions.signature: (gross_premium: float, diversification: float, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

Next12month eligible LOB28 earned gross premiums; AnnexIII DIV supplied.

Exclude nonproportional obligations relating to LOB9/21. DIV is based on
earned premiums, not the premium/reserve volume measure. Qualification and
DIV derivation remain external; the reference is not regulatory approval.

functions.name: other_nonlife_cat_loss
functions.signature: (group_premiums: Mapping, *, classification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
All five AnnexXII groups, next12month earned gross premiums.

Classify obligations and exclusions externally, including the conditional
extended-warranty exclusion in group3. Groups1/2 combine before squaring.

functions.name: motor_assumed_limit
functions.signature: (amounts: Mapping, basis: str, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Externally choose total, absent-total property/personal, or per-victim basis.

functions.name: motor_cat_loss
functions.signature: (high_count: float, low_count: float, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

Gross sudden claim, with literal floor even at zero supplied counts.

Counts are already proportionally weighted. Whether this submodule applies
to the undertaking is external; this API does not invent a zero-book waiver.

functions.name: motor_vehicle_count
functions.signature: (vehicles: Mapping, category: str, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

Aggregate qualified LOB4/16 vehicle groups, proportional shares applied once.

Vehicle counts are whole numbers before weighting; the resulting count can
be fractional. Each group must have a single assumed coverage limit/share.

functions.name: catastrophe_effective_sum
functions.signature: (gross_sum: float, recoverable: float, use_gross: bool | None, peril: str, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Qualified recovery subtraction or explicit gross fallback for inadequate risk capture.

Recoveries conditional on unrelated claims must have been excluded externally.
For vessel components apply separately; for other perils use the qualified
combined object/group sum. The returned amount is not a BOF loss or SCR.

functions.name: manmade_concentration_loss
functions.signature: (exposures: Mapping, peril: str, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Maximum combined effective insured sum of externally qualified objects.

Fire inputs are complete, externally qualified building groups, not isolated
points. Components are after qualified recovery/fallback; never deduct twice.
Empty eligible populations return explicitly documented conventional zero.
This is not the hypothetical Article196(a) capital calculation; its2027
object-selection requirements need separate qualification.

functions.name: liability_cat_claim_count
functions.signature: (loss: float, unlimited: bool | None, largest_limit: float | None = None, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Smallest integer STRICTLY above the ratio, or one for unlimited coverage.

Fraction arithmetic on decimal representations preserves exact boundaries
such as 115/(1.15*100)=1; ceil would be wrong there. Representative loss
allocation across those claims and reinsurance response remain external.

functions.name: liability_cat_loss
functions.signature: (group: str, gross_premium: float, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Group factor times next12month earned gross premium before reinsurance.

AnnexXI classifications and exclusions are external, including the group4
exclusions for groups1–3, private households and specified craftsmen.

functions.name: credit_cat_default_loss

functions.description:
Select largest NET default exposures and report their gross scenario claims.

Each recovery is externally valued against this exposure's default claim,
not against its full insured sum. Ambiguous cutoff ties with differing gross
amounts require explicit selection, still constrained to largest net losses.

functions.name: credit_cat_recession_loss
functions.signature: (gross_premium: float, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

external inputs. This component does not bootstrap or extrapolate a curve.

swaps requiring adjustment; the external reference must establish that scope.

functions.signature: (*, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context, calibration: Optional[Mapping] = None)
functions.description:

EIOPA-BoS-24-533 8.3.2 / EIOPA-BoS-26-198 7.3.2. A company's formula
result is NOT the uniform adjustment published for all undertakings.

functions.name: rfr_market_rate_adjustment
functions.signature: (market_rate: float, credit_adjustment: float, currency_adjustment: float, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

this is not a shift to an already extrapolated curve or a VA/MA operation.

functions.name: rfr_transitional_spot_rate
functions.signature: (spot_rate: float, legacy_rate: float, equivalent_annual_rate: float, *, matching_adjustment_used: bool | None, technical_provisions_transition_used: bool | None, approval_reference: str, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

basis including applicable VA. Existing rfr_equivalent_annual_rate can solve
nonnegative cashflows; mixed-sign portfolios need qualified external roots.

functions.name: technical_provisions_transitional_value
functions.signature: (current_gross_provisions: float, base_solvency2_net_provisions: float, base_legacy_net_provisions: float, *, supervisory_deduction_limit: float | None, risk_free_transition_used: bool | None, approval_reference: str, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

Base amounts are NET on the Article308d(2) date or approved recalibration;

preserve decimal grid/threshold boundaries and never fill missing years.

functions.signature: (market_rates: collections.abc.Mapping, first_smoothing_point: float, maturity: float, *, instrument_kind: str, coupon_frequency: int | None = None, average_notionals: collections.abc.Mapping | None = None, ufr: float, phase_in: bool | None, approval_reference: str | None = None, volatility_adjustment: float | None = None, matching_adjustment: float | None = None, interest_stress: str | None = None, output_maturities=(), qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

rounded to whole basis points; its continuous equivalent enters LLFR.

functions.name: risk_mitigation_recognition_factor
functions.signature: (remaining_months: float, conditions: Mapping, *, purpose: str, instrument_kind: str, finite_or_similar: bool | None, replacement: Optional[Mapping] = None, proportional_factor: float | None = None, counterparty_factor: float = 1, residential_guarantee_payment_months: float | None = None, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

Coverage is SCR/local-equivalent solvency coverage for the insurer route,

functions.signature: (obligations: collections.abc.Mapping, *, runoff_complete: bool, cashflow_reference: str, curve_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

cover/guarantee or enforceable future premiums disapply this exception.

SRC-0211 construction; components b run
from FSP to later liquid maturities. Only a receives the explicit VA.
Market selection, forward derivation and VA qualification are external.
Here volatility_adjustment is a CONTINUOUS forward increment; the
integrated rfr_curve_spot_2027 converts annual VA using log1p first.

functions.name: group_sector_capital_requirement_2027
functions.signature: (sector: str, requirements: Mapping, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Select the prescribed maximum of complete externally calculated branches.

Bank inputs include applicable buffers/add-ons, not just Pillar1 minima.
Pension inputs cover both the required margin and national requirement.
This component implements no CRR, IFR, IORP or third-country valuation.

functions.name: group_sector_contribution_2027
functions.signature: (entities: Mapping, *, measure: str, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Sum disjoint qualified sector amounts using subscribed-capital shares.

Eligible own funds must already reflect Article228 availability exclusions.
Subgroup inclusion, exclusion of its individual members and supervisory
decisions are externally qualified. Signed own funds are not floored.

functions.name: group_combined_component_surplus_2027
functions.signature: (consolidated_own_funds: float, consolidated_scr: float, minimum: float, method2_related: Mapping, sector_contributions: Mapping, method2_own_funds_adjustment: float, method2_capital_addon: float, *, approval_reference: str, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Compose externally approved disjoint methods, not a consolidation model.

Consolidated inputs already exclude M2/sector holdings and reflect required
currency sensitivity. Do not repeat pure-M2 participation-value deductions.
M2 insurer subsidiary deficits retain Article221 treatment; sector amounts
are already weighted and availability-adjusted under Article228.

functions.name: group_combined_currency_exposure_2027
functions.signature: (participation_value: float, entity_scr: float, share: float, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Positive holding excess for external consolidated currency scenarios.

Amounts use the same qualified currency. This is not a currency charge and
no equity shock applies to this holding under the cited combined-method rule.

functions.name: scope_volume_conditions
functions.signature: (gross_written_premiums: float, gross_technical_provisions: float, reinsurance_written_premiums: float, reinsurance_technical_provisions: float, *, part_of_group: bool | None, group_gross_technical_provisions: float | None = None, has_disallowed_business: bool | None, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Screen one year's literal Article4(1) conditions in the selected profile.

Inputs are externally qualified gross EUR amounts. No netting or zero floor
is inferred. Article4(2-5) time rules, authorisation and cross-border business
must be assessed separately; a result of1 is not a scope exemption.

functions.name: scope_ancillary_risk_conditions
functions.signature: (ancillary_branch: int, main_branch: int, *, main_risk_authorised: bool | None, linked_to_main: bool | None, same_object: bool | None, same_contract: bool | None, legal_expenses_exception: str | None = None, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Apply Article16's cross-branch conditions to external factual declarations.

Credit/surety remain prohibited. Legal expenses require the assistance main
branch and the explicitly declared travel or sea-vessel exception; all base
conditions still apply. This function does not grant or verify a licence.

functions.name: scope_volume_entry_trigger
functions.signature: (annual_exceedance: collections.abc.Sequence, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Three-year breach of one identified amount, for the following-year trigger.

Period consecutiveness and historically applicable thresholds are externally
qualified. Different monetary criteria must not be mixed within a series.
This component does not select an effective legal regime for the entity.

functions.name: scope_volume_release_history
functions.signature: (past_any_exceedance: collections.abc.Sequence, forecast_any_exceedance: collections.abc.Sequence, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Only historical/prospective volume conditions, not supervisory release.

Forecasts are external. Cross-border activity, voluntary authorisation and
supervisory satisfaction remain separate, even when this indicator is1.

functions.name: group_consolidated_minimum
functions.signature: (parent_mcr: float, related: Mapping, *, qualification_reference: str, third_country: Optional[Mapping] = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Qualified MCR sum plus future local licence-withdrawal requirements.

Future third-country rows are explicit, including an empty mapping. They
must not duplicate the EU-MCR entity set; legal scope is assessed externally.

functions.name: group_consolidated_surplus
functions.signature: (eligible_own_funds: float, calculated_scr: float, minimum: float, *, qualification_reference: str, sector_contributions: Optional[Mapping] = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
External consolidated eligible EOF minus SCR after its qualified minimum.

This is not consolidation by adding individual SCRs. Input SCR must include
externally required add-ons; EOF qualification and minimum coverage remain
externally assessed. A negative surplus is deliberately retained.
Future Article228 sectors must be excluded from consolidated inputs and
added separately, after the minimum is applied to consolidated SCR only.

functions.name: group_immaterial_participation_screen_2027
functions.signature: (consolidated_assets: float, book_values: Mapping, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Strict numerical thresholds only, never supervisory permission.

All relevant holdings and consolidated assets are externally qualified.
Exact decimal comparisons avoid a rounding tolerance at either boundary.

functions.name: group_simplified_participation_scr_2027
functions.signature: (participation_risk: float, *, entity_type: str, capital_requirement: float | None = None, approval_reference: str, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Externally approved simplified contribution; no extra ownership weighting.

Article228 entities are outside scope. Third-country capital information
must be supplied, never replaced with zero when unavailable.

functions.name: group_method2_component_surplus
functions.signature: (parent_own_funds: float, parent_scr: float, related: Mapping, own_funds_adjustment: float, capital_addon: float, *, qualification_reference: str, sector_contributions: Optional[Mapping] = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Signed method2 aggregation component, not complete approved group solvency.

Participation values already represent the held direct/indirect investment:
never apply share twice. External EOF adjustments must not duplicate those
values or the full-subsidiary-deficit correction calculated here. Group
availability, tiers, intra-group transactions and scope are not inferred.
Future Article228 sectors are explicit, already weighted and disjoint;
their holding values are deducted once, not passed through insurer deficits.

functions.name: group_required_shortfall
functions.signature: (eligible_own_funds: float, scr: float, share: float, is_subsidiary: bool | None, proportionate_deficit_approved: bool | None, approval_reference: str | None = None, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Full subsidiary deficit unless an explicit externally approved exception applies.

functions.name: group_method2_best_estimate_sum
functions.signature: (parent_best_estimate: float, related: Mapping, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Parent plus proportionate related BE, preserving signed external valuations.

Calculate before/after removal of intra-group transactions separately; this
component does not invent an EOF-adjustment sign or revalue transactions.

functions.name: group_standard_scr_contribution
functions.signature: (entity: str, share: float, diversified_component: float, component_scrs: Mapping, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Standard-formula contribution for externally qualified consolidated entities.

Numerator uses the entity's proportional SCR; denominator is the sum of the
supplied SCRs, without applying shares a second time. No internal-model
allocation is inferred. Scaling preserves the formula at large magnitudes.

functions.name: group_consolidated_best_estimate
functions.signature: (parent_best_estimate: float, related: Mapping, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Sum BE already adjusted externally for all intra-group transactions.

Method1 Article335(1)a/c scope and consolidation shares are external. The
receiving reinsurer excludes intra-group fulfilment cashflows; the cedant
excludes corresponding recoverables. This function does not perform netting.

functions.name: group_consolidated_risk_margin
functions.signature: (parent_risk_margin: float, related: Mapping, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Proportionate sum of externally qualified risk margins, no added diversification.

functions.name: group_consolidated_scr
functions.signature: (components: Mapping, capital_addon: float, *, qualification_reference: str, simplified_contributions: Optional[Mapping] = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Sum qualified Article336 amounts plus externally set group add-on.

Contributions b/c already include proportional shares. Components d/e are
externally determined risk amounts, not invented sums of individual SCRs.
From 2027, only a-d belong here; separate Article336b additions must be
explicit and disjoint from those components. Article228 sector contributions
are outside this consolidated amount. Their valuation is not inferred.
Apply the Article230 minimum separately. No sector/Look-through valuation
or supervisory determination is implemented by this composition function.

functions.name: group_reinsurance_elimination
functions.signature: (entities: Mapping, transactions: Mapping, *, parent_id: str, measure: str, other_intragroup_adjustments_complete: bool, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Remove qualified internal reinsurance values before consolidation shares.

Entity gross BE and recoverables must include the supplied disjoint internal
transactions, but already exclude all OTHER required intragroup adjustments.
Assumed obligation PV and ceded recoverable need not agree: valuation bases
and shares can differ. Neither side is inferred from the other or floored.
This is a two-sided ledger adjustment, not a projection or legal approval.

functions.name: natural_cat_event_loss
functions.signature: (prescribed_loss: float, peril: str, scenario: str, event: int, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
One ordered gross event; do not replace sequential recoveries with a sum.

Article126 independence, no new mitigation between events, and realistic
existing reinstatements must be reflected in external sequence valuation.

functions.name: natural_cat_insured_sum
functions.signature: (peril: str, components: Mapping, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Sum eligible zone exposures; flood/hail motor weights differ.

Classify LOB7/19 property, LOB6/18 onshore property and LOB5/17 motor
externally. Subsidence covers eligible residential property; its region
scope is France historically, Annex VIIIA regions in the 2027 profile.

functions.name: natural_cat_other_loss
functions.signature: (peril: str, gross_premium: float, diversification: float, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Outside AnnexXIII: eligible next12month gross premiums and external DIV.

DIV uses the prescribed premium basis for AnnexIII regions5–18, not generic
premium/reserve volumes. Geographic membership is not inferred here.

functions.name: natural_cat_scenario_risk
functions.signature: (peril: str, scenario_charges: Mapping, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Maximum of externally valued A/B sequence capital, not sum of event losses.

functions.name: natural_cat_weighted_cap
functions.signature: (weighted_sum: float, peril: str, use_alternative: bool | None, potential_gross_loss: float | None = None, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Optional externally justified lower WSI, never a reinsurance-net amount.

functions.name: health_accident_benefit_mean
functions.signature: (benefits: Mapping, *, valuation_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context, group_counts: Optional[Mapping] = None, grouping_reference: str | None = None)
functions.description:
Average only event-insured persons in the externally selected concentration.

The denominator is event-specific Ne, not the whole building count Cc.
Empty event populations require review, never an invented zero mean.

functions.name: health_accident_benefit_sum
functions.signature: (benefits: Mapping, *, valuation_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context, group_counts: Optional[Mapping] = None, grouping_reference: str | None = None)
functions.description: Sum externally qualified event benefits of resident insured persons.

functions.name: health_accident_concentration_loss
functions.signature: (persons: float, mean_benefits: Mapping, *, concentration_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Use the externally identified largest qualified building population, not largest loss.

functions.name: health_accident_country_aggregation
functions.signature: (country_charges: Mapping, peril: str, *, scope_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Root-sum-square of already valued country BOF charges, never of gross claims.

functions.name: health_mass_accident_loss
functions.signature: (segment: str, event_exposures: Mapping, *, exposure_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Gross claim for one printed AnnexXVI segment, before reinsurance and BOF revaluation.

functions.name: health_pandemic_income_exposure
functions.signature: (benefits: Mapping, *, valuation_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)

functions.name: health_pandemic_loss
functions.signature: (income_exposure: float, countries: Mapping, *, exposure_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Gross sudden scenario claim before reinsurance; country residence/scope external.

functions.name: health_pandemic_medical_cost
functions.signature: (costs: Mapping, *, valuation_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Weight all three externally valued care types; never silently normalise overrides.

functions.name: health_lapse_option_stress
functions.signature: (exercise_rate: float, direction: str, *, option_kind: str, selected: bool | None, selection_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Stress relevant exercise/non-exercise probability with health-specific parameters.

functions.name: health_lapse_risk
functions.signature: (gross_losses: Mapping, net_losses: Mapping, *, valuation_reference: str, tie_break: str | None = None, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Select the gross SLT health lapse charge corresponding to maximum net loss.

functions.name: health_mass_lapse_factor
functions.signature: (category: str, *, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description:
Return the40% event share, not proportional capital or life special-category70%.

Uniform joint events, underlying reinsurance contracts and the worst
termination form require external qualification in either reference profile.

functions.name: health_expense_inflation_stress
functions.signature: (inflation_rate: float, *, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Add the expense inflation shock without choosing a projection convention.

functions.name: health_expense_level_stress
functions.signature: (expense: float, *, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Stress eligible own/cedent costs jointly with inflation in external projection.

functions.name: health_revision_stress
functions.signature: (annuity_benefit: float, *, revision_exposed: bool | None, qualification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Stress externally selected inflation/legal/health revision-exposed annuities.

functions.name: health_disability_risk
functions.signature: (medical_charge: float, income_protection_charge: float, *, classification_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Sum disjoint SLT medical/income charges; no diversification or classification inference.

functions.name: health_medical_inflation_stress
functions.signature: (inflation_rate: float, direction: str, *, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Add/subtract percentage points without inventing a compounding model.

functions.name: health_medical_payment_stress
functions.signature: (payment: float, direction: str, *, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Stress payments jointly with inflation in the external permanent projection.

functions.name: health_medical_risk
functions.signature: (up_charge: float, down_charge: float, *, valuation_reference: str, context: solvency2._core.core.Context)
functions.description: Maximum of two joint-scenario charges; no extra net-selection rule is inferred.

functions.name: DiscountCurve
functions.signature: (curve_id: 'str', as_of: 'str', currency: 'str', curve_kind: 'str', source_reference: 'str', points: 'tuple[tuple[str, float], ...]') -> None
functions.description:
Immutable external factors keyed by payment date, with content provenance.

Factors above one are valid. No curve is considered an official or approved
curve merely because its format is valid. Values are never interpolated.

functions.name: load_discount_curve_json
functions.signature: (path: 'str | Path') -> 'DiscountCurve'
functions.description: Load a local UTF-8 version-1 curve; reject duplicate JSON keys.

functions.name: load_discount_curve_csv
functions.signature: (path: 'str | Path', *, curve_id: 'str', as_of: 'str', currency: 'str', curve_kind: 'str', source_reference: 'str') -> 'DiscountCurve'
functions.description:
Load date,discount_factor CSV; metadata must be supplied explicitly.

UTF-8, comma separator, decimal point, no unit or locale guessing. Source
paths are not added to result provenance; use a suitable source reference.

functions.name: best_estimate_with_curve
functions.signature: (cashflows: 'Mapping[str, Mapping]', *, curve: 'DiscountCurve', runoff_complete: 'bool', cashflow_reference: 'str', context: 'Context') -> 'Result'
functions.description:
Bind external factors to expected cashflows and call the existing BE formula.

Rows contain expected_inflows and expected_outflows in the context currency.
No projection, curve qualification, VA/MA addition or currency conversion.

functions.name: discount_curve_from_spot_rates
functions.signature: (points: 'Mapping[str, Mapping]', *, curve_id: 'str', curve_kind: 'str', source_reference: 'str', time_basis_reference: 'str', context: 'Context') -> 'DiscountCurve'
functions.description:
Convert annual-effective decimal spot rates using the existing RFR formula.

Each payment date maps to annual_effective_rate and time_years. The caller
supplies year fractions and their convention: no calendar/day-count guess,
percent conversion, interpolation, or extrapolation is performed. The full
raw input and convention are fingerprinted in the source reference.

functions.name: numeric_overrides_from_dict
functions.signature: (payload: Mapping) -> tuple[solvency2._core.core.NumericOverride, ...]
functions.description:
Parse schema_version=1 and an overrides list; apply with Context.overrides.

Resource names and existing numeric paths are validated by the selected
Context when used. Parsing is not regulatory qualification. Empty batches
are allowed and mean the original, unmodified parameter set.

functions.name: load_numeric_overrides_json
functions.signature: (path: str | pathlib.Path) -> tuple[solvency2._core.core.NumericOverride, ...]
functions.description: Load an explicit local UTF-8 scenario file; never edit installed data.

functions.name: api_catalogue
functions.signature: () -> dict
functions.description: Return fresh function names, domain paths, signatures and contracts.

functions.name: reference_datasets
functions.signature: () -> list[str]
functions.description: Names of additional synthetic reporting datasets (no filesystem paths).

functions.name: reference_dataset
functions.signature: (name: str) -> dict
functions.description: Read an explicitly named dataset, independent of the working directory.

functions.name: documentation
functions.signature: (topic: str = 'README') -> str
functions.description:
Return bundled English Markdown without needing a browser or source tree.

Topics: README, API, DATA, PARAMETERS, RECIPES, LIMITATIONS, DEVELOPMENT,
ACCEPTANCE, DISCLAIMER, SECURITY, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES, CHANGELOG.
